answer: The horizon is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the grove. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, weighted by independent path length, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the ferrous of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
